fitted_on: train split (seed 42) of hybrid_dataset_clean.csv after p1/p99 capping fitted on train
order: ranking first, correlation filter afterwards (filter uses the ranking to decide which of a pair to drop)
why_in_degree_is_top_ranked: The ranking is computed on all 24 features before pruning, so in_degree keeps rank 2. The correlation filter then removes it from the 'corr_pruned' subset only. 'top_k' subsets are cut from the unpruned ranking and still contain it, and the production model uses all 25 S2 features (no selection applied).
